title: Constrained-network delivery: remove round trips before shaving semantics
summary: GPRS-class networks expose request latency and uncached module waterfalls. Production-like Wire UI delivery prelinks the immutable JS runtime into one content-addressed gzip module, caches immutable runtime/definitions/resources, and keeps bootstrap/session/live state fresh.
invariants: Optimisation must not change Wire UI semantics or move business state into the browser.
Development/source mode may remain modular and no-store; optimised delivery serves one content-addressed precompressed runtime with immutable caching.
HTML/bootstrap/session/live state remain non-cacheable or separately governed.
Warm clients should reuse immutable runtime, exact definitions and approved resources and receive only fresh authoritative state/deltas.
Constrained-network mode may reduce prefetch aggressiveness and select approved constrained resource representations, but may not change business eligibility or semantic journey.
GPRS/EDGE profiles should remain mandatory performance acceptance cases because modern networks hide avoidable request/round-trip waste.

provenance.claim: Deterministic one-module content-addressed gzip distribution changes only static runtime delivery.
CONSTRAINED delivery may select smaller approved representation without changing exact resource identity.
Builder launcher includes source/optimised runtime delivery and remains orchestration/static/bootstrap rather than application authority.
